name: Prateek
site: landal.com · Holiday parks and bungalows, Netherlands
headline: Turn Landal’s booking data into stays that come back.
saw: Your homepage sells bungalows and apartments in over 200 parks, with autumn, Christmas and last minute offers, and every visitor sees the same promotions, whether they booked last year or are about to book again.

Guests with a customer login or my account leave a clear signal: what they book, when they travel, which parks they return to and which offers they open. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the guest receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to lapse this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Keep returning guests before they lapse
cases.text: For each guest with a customer login, the AI reads booking rhythm and park history and picks the offer, channel and moment that keeps them returning, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right upgrade to each guest
cases.text: Next best park, bungalow or add-on for each customer, picked from what they booked and which offers they opened. No more promotions sent to guests who already booked.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every guest browsing between stays
cases.text: Personal content on your homepage and in email, from park pages to the autumn and winter offers, so every guest has a reason to plan the next holiday.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
